text:
emily g: Heads-up — syncing on SEO tasks for next week's launch + webinar funnel. want to lock keyword targets and redirect plan today.
sam r: ok, pinging the kw list now. top priority = 'real-time llm inference cost' + longtail variants.
maria k: i'll draft two launch posts: one benchmark narrative (cost vs latency) and one product-first howto (webinar CTA).
liam p: for webinar page we need schema + registration microdata. can we do FAQ + Event structured data?
emily g: yes: Event (start/end, registration url), Organization, and FAQ. also canonical linking to the launch post and the docs hub.
sam r: quick note on internals — we'll consolidate 3 legacy pages into /platform/inference/ to reduce keyword dilution. need redirect map.
alex (ops-bot): deploy-checklist reminder: update sitemap.xml and notify search-console after redirects applied :white_check_mark:
emily g: sam/maria — i sketched a redirect capsule. short mapping here:

```
/old-inference-guide -> /platform/inference/guide
/inference-benchmarks-2023 -> /platform/inference/benchmarks
/webinar-signup-v1 -> /events/webinar-real-time-2026
```
we should add 301s and preserve UTM if present.
sam r: agree 301. also add hreflang for en-US/en-GB variants where applicable.
maria k: for internal linking — i'm going to add an anchor cluster linking the launch post -> benchmarks -> faq -> docs quickstart. want to keep 3-4 contextual links per page, not more.
liam p: tagging/analytics: please ensure registration form adds utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=real-time-llm so marketing can route leads.
emily g: inbound lead routing — hubspot play: create workflow that assigns leads from webinar page to SDR queue 'Webinar-RealTime-2026' and adds lead_source=webinar.
liam p: also add funnel event in GA4: event = 'webinar_reg', param = {"campaign":"real-time-llm"}
sam r: schema checklist before publish:
- Event schema with offers.url
- FAQ schema snippets
- BreadcrumbList
- Organization markup on footer
- canonical + open graph tags
maria k: copy nits: headline must include target phrase in h1 and meta title, but keep it human first. i'll share two title options in thread.
emily g: timing: aim to have redirects staged by EOD tomorrow, schema + canonical in place by noon on day of publish, analytics wiring before launch email.
sam r: i'll run a quick Screaming Frog crawl after redirects and report any 404 chains.
alex (ops-bot): NOTE: scheduled sitemap ping to search console set for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC
emily g: perfect. last ask — if anyone spots content cannibalization risk, flag here. we'll decide canonical and split intent.
maria k: on it. i'll drop the title options and the anchor list in the thread in 30m.
liam p: i'll update the redirect spreadsheet and share the link.
sam r: thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
